name: zsnd_gain_scale_to_directsound_attenuation
description: zSnd::GainScaleToDirectSoundAttenuation converts linear gain into DirectSound attenuation with the original zero and clamp behavior.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Binary Ninja reconstruction remains limited around x87 status-word rendering, but assembly and smoke behavior agree on the caller-visible int return.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x49f9a0 validates gain >= 1 returning 0, very small gain clamping to -10000, and the intermediate log2 conversion through _ftol.
The native smoke verifies unity/greater-than-unity zero attenuation, clamp-to--10000 behavior, and representative half/quarter gain attenuation values.
